subject.title: Reduce tool schema token overhead (~3,500 tok/session)

question: Which default policy should OpenClaw use for reducing fixed tool-schema and prompt overhead across providers, channel plugins, cron/isolated agents, and future plugin SDK surfaces?
rationale: The remaining work changes model-facing defaults and plugin/provider contracts, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term compatibility boundary by itself.

options.title: Incremental measured reductions
options.body: Keep the umbrella open and sequence small measured changes that preserve current behavior by default while adding deferred or scoped schema paths where contracts are clear.

options.title: Defer to narrower trackers
options.body: Close or downgrade this umbrella only if maintainers want #14619, #98300, #55071, and adjacent diagnostics to own all remaining work independently.

options.title: Adopt aggressive pruning by default
options.body: Make slim schemas and prompt elision the default sooner, accepting higher compatibility risk for cron, isolated agents, and plugin-provided tools.

recommendation.title: Incremental measured reductions
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella open and sequence small measured changes that preserve current behavior by default while adding deferred or scoped schema paths where contracts are clear.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the current maintainer sequencing and adjacent Tool Search/prompt-runtime work among the identified owners.
